Name: Profession Icons Redone
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
Don't you love it when you realise that there's a tiny inconsistency in Stardew that you would never have noticed until someone pointed it out? Well, I'm here to point out that the icons for the level 5 and level 10 profession choices are based on what is probably outdated game art! I also offer you a fix. All patches are configurable by setting them to "false" in the generated ﻿[font=Courier New]config[/font] file.

These icons were changed:
[list]
[*]Acrobat
[*]Agriculturalist
[*]Angler
[*]Artisan
[*]Blacksmith
[*]Brute
[*]Botanist
[*]Coopmaster
[*]Defender
[*]Desperado
[*]Excavator
[*]Fisher
[*]Geologist
[*]Luremaster
[*]Mariner
[*]Miner
[*]Pirate
[*]Prospector
[*]Rancher
[*]Scout
[*]Tapper
[*]Tiller
[*]Tracker
[*]Trapper
[/list]
Have a look at the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Skills]Skills[/url]﻿ page on the Wiki to clarify what each profession enhances and what each icon represents.

Install
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Updated to work for 1.6, and a couple of new additions to the pack! Download and unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods.
